snippet.title: Lost Railway - World Premiere Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Lost Railway: https://store.steampowered.com/app/862750 

Lost Railway is the first 2D co-op quota horror where you and your friends travel through a strange, cute-but-creepy post-apocalyptic world aboard a train that must never stop. You scavenge abandoned stations, avoid or in worst case confront monsters, and race against an escalating level of the mutation on the level while fulfilling a quota that keeps the train moving. Every run is a tense balance between greed, caution, and teamwork. Screaming is not just allowed, it is a mechanic. This is quota horror reimagined for 2D: systemic, readable, brutal, with active deep combat and deeply co-op-driven.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
